desc: mg-A-res1 win02 (cumulative, includes win01): +0x24fd8 set_coin_creator, +0x23e40 (win01); native 754/150, 0 losses. set handler moved to instructions/coin_creator/set_coin_creator.rs (mg-A-2/creatorfees-r1 port: let base_mint = pool.base_mint; require_keys_eq!(pool.creator, crate::utils::pool_authority(&base_mint), ..) at original line 63; let pool_key = pool.key(); match on &metadata.creators) and made EXTERNAL/non-inlined: lib.rs line 26 `pub use instructions::{boost, liquidity, swap::trade_v2, coin_creator::{migrate_pool_coin_creator, set_coin_creator}};` (same line), no #[inline]. Source shape that closes the window: (1) each arm builds its event in a block `let event = { let timestamp = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp; let base_mint = base_mint; let metadata = ctx.accounts.metadata.key(); Event { timestamp, base_mint, pool: pool_key, metadata, coin_creator } };` - removes the field temps whose lifetime.end markers pushed the DSE MemorySSA scan of the dead event+32/event+96 copies to exactly the 150 limit (orig had no such copies); (2) the Some(creators) arm ends with `return Ok(());` - its error-return phi then keeps scalar (i64, ptr) parts (InstCombine cannot fold the phi of extractvalues into an aggregate phi), which reproduces the original scheduling of the emit_cpi! Error::from block (data-Rc load first) and the tail-merge direction. Behavior unchanged (same event values, same order of checks/CPI). POSITIONING DEVICES: set_coin_creator.rs has 45 blank lines + 9 comment-only lines (//, ///) in lines 3-62 plus a 3-line doc comment so require_keys_eq! is on line 63; creator_reassignment.rs: set fn replaced by `pub use crate::instructions::coin_creator::set_coin_creator::set;` + blank lines (line-neutral, same for migrate from win01). File moves: set and migrate handlers moved from creator_reassignment.rs to instructions/coin_creator/{set_coin_creator,migrate_pool_coin_creator}.rs. Patch is diff -ruN (includes new files).
